rows.whatChanged:
ONE CHANGE, IN THE SHARED HOST, BECAUSE THE DEFECT IS THE HOST'S AND THIS FAMILY'S BUILDER IS A THREE-LINE SHIM.
scripts/build-census-v1-ga-fugitive-j5-set.mjs contains nothing but `runGaFamily("ga-fugitive-j5-set")`; every line of Georgia content, and the pagination that produced the defect, lives in scripts/build-census-v1-ga-host.mjs. There is no builder to put the change in, so it went into the host and was proved to leave every sibling byte-identical.

(1) THE ROUTE-KEY-ONLY PAGE IS GONE. renderComposedPdf drew row by row and started a new page whenever y fell below the margin, which is exactly rowsPerPage = Math.floor((height - 2 * margin) / lineHeight) + 1 = 45 rows a page. The certificate of service filled those 45 rows exactly, so the blank line and the trailer that follow it were pushed onto a page of their own and page 5 of six was delivered carrying one line of ink: "Route: obligation:track-only:GA:ga-fugitive-j5". The same rows are now laid into the same 45-row grid before anything is drawn, and the sole-occupant trailer pull-down from the Oklahoma composer (scripts/build-census-v1-rcap-ok-custom-pleading.mjs) is applied to the settled layout: same soleOccupant predicate (page.length > 0 && page.every(r => r.trailer || r.text === "")), same whole-block move of the previous page's last block, same refusal to move a block that would not fit, same guard. This is FIX35's move onto this host's own pagination rather than a new scheme. No constant moved, no block-cohesion rule (OK's Rule 1 / Rule 1b) was imported, and pages are still created and drawn one at a time in the original order, which is why every component that did not end on a trailer-only page is byte-identical.
Delivered page 5 now reads, verbatim and in this order: "This page is not proof of service and does not say that anything has been served. It is completed and" / "signed when the copies actually go out. A date or a signature written before the copies go out would be" / "false." / "Route: obligation:track-only:GA:ga-fugitive-j5". Those three prose rows are the ones that stood at the foot of page 4 before; nothing was written and nothing was removed. Page count 6 -> 6.
A build-time assertion now proves it on every build: assert.ok(!pages.some(soleOccupant), "renderComposedPdf left a page carrying only the route trailer in ...").

(2) THE PREPARER-VOICE LINE ON PAGE 3 WAS ALREADY THERE, VERBATIM, AND NOTHING WAS CHANGED IN THE ORDER. The assignment offered two remedies for the key printing under "JUDGE, SUPERIOR COURT": give this family the preparer-voice line the passing Georgia siblings carry between the JUDGE caption and the trailer, verbatim, or move the trailer above the block. Read off the delivered bytes at the base, this family already carries the first one. Line 1101 of the host pushes it for every family, and canonical and boundary page 3 print, in this order and nothing between them: "JUDGE, SUPERIOR COURT" (y=140.0) / "(The judge's signature block is a third-party block. It is never prefilled, and the court dates its own order.)" (y=125.5) / "Route: obligation:track-only:GA:ga-fugitive-j5" (y=96.5). Character for character, that middle line is the line VF07 recorded as linesDrawnBetweenSignatureLineAndTrailer on ga-felony-j1-set, ga-misd-j4-set and ga-vacated-j2-set and passed them on. The only textual difference from those three is the caption itself, "JUDGE, SUPERIOR COURT" against "JUDGE, COURT NAMED IN THE CAPTION", which is F.captionKind and not a placement.
So the remedy the assignment named is already in place and there was nothing verbatim to add. The second remedy was refused, and refused deliberately: moving the trailer above the JUDGE block is a host rule, it would move all eight siblings, and doing it for this family alone would break the parity with the three siblings that passed on precisely this shape. Page 3 is untouched - its 110dpi raster is byte-identical before and after (sha256 84bc2e34997909fcaa49bfc183f94ce3b48b5bec20cc24538ed6ee4828c5a470) - and nothing in the decretal block, the findings, the SO ORDERED line, the signature rule, the entry date or the court terms moved. This is reported rather than repaired, and an independent reader should treat SCAN02 class c on this family as the open question VF07 and VF08 answered differently on identical structure.
